source: WotLK 3.3.5a hunter baseline verified from 腰果猎人's live spellbook and trainer on 2026-11-03; live inventory on 2026-11-04 exposed zero ammunition, so Rough Arrow is protected and replenished before bag upgrades. Version 3 binds replenishment to Duokna's live-observed position and the measured south-side route. Duokna's live vendor list and a 600-arrow purchase were verified on 2026-11-04. Version 4 disables melee auto-attack so the hunter can open at 20 yards with Auto Shot instead of running into melee; arrow consumption and ranged damage remain under live validation. Version 5 gates Raptor Strike to its four-yard melee range after live out-of-range cast failures at ranged distance. Version 6 binds zero-durability equipment recovery to live-observed repair-capable NPC flags; Ghrawt completed a real repair on 2026-11-04, raising the equipped bow from 0/20 to 20/20 for 48 copper. Version 7 opens Auto Shot at its 30-yard ranged window instead of approaching to 20 yards while the target charges, and excludes it inside eight yards. Version 8 selects Rough Arrow through CMSG_SET_AMMO before Auto Shot; a live controlled shot on 2026-11-04 produced SMSG_SPELL_GO, reduced the target from 137 to 129 health and consumed one arrow (600 to 599). Version 9 restocks at 100 arrows instead of treating every consumed arrow as a vendor emergency, and never asks a non-repair merchant to repair equipment.
